title: Introduce Parameter Object

solutions.title: A DateRange the report can ask questions of
solutions.tradeoff: A type to construct at every entry point, and a standing invitation to keep adding getters to it. Worth it only because the two dates already had behaviour waiting for them.

reviewFocus: Did the two dates travel together in every signature, or is there one place where only `from` was needed? A parameter object over values that do not always travel together is ceremony.
How many methods did the new type attract? Zero means you introduced a record, not an object - the smell is still there wearing a nicer coat.
Is `renderRangeLine` inside the type or outside it? Both are defensible; the answer should be an argument, not an accident.
Were the three entry points migrated one at a time, with the suite green in between, or did the signature change land in one commit?
Does any caller still compute a `to` date by hand? The month report is the one that hides.
